column1: # Where update.py reads the certificates of keys that cannot be trusted (ADR 0023). Columns: kind, name,
#   aosp-test   AOSP's public test keys, whose private halves are in the AOSP source; any device that
#               trusts one trusts code that anyone can sign;
#   google-dev  Google's development keys, used for emulator and other development images; the
#               compatibility tests reject them on certified phones.
# Formats: pem (an X.509 certificate in PEM) or der; googlesource serves both as base64 (?format=TEXT).
# The leaked platform certificates are in leaked.tsv, copied by hand from Google's list.
